scenarios.label: Independents caucus with Republicans
scenarios.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Republican caucus; King and Sanders remain Democratic.

control.description: Counterfactual: all four modeled independent opposition contenders join Republican caucus; King and Sanders remain Democratic.

limitations: Explicit35-principal-pair approximation with65 fixed non-up holders; preserved rule and omitted-option assumptions.

Four independent first contenders in ID/MT/NE/SD retain I party labels. D/R-trained candidate and national/context coefficients are borrowed for their opposition-share proxies without empirical transfer qualification.
This current proxy chamber target is separate from the matched historical ordinary-D/R plus categorical-fallback chamber law.
Poll likelihood and covariance are the exact saved49-observation fixed empirical comparator; covariance estimation uncertainty is not integrated.
Additional future draws do not improve the finite historical posterior bank effective sample size.
No2026 outcome or accuracy claim; historical final-roster proxy and source revision qualifications remain in the panel receipt.
Frozen nonpoll inputs have2026-10-20T15:21:23Z cutoff; the preserved49-poll batch has its separate saved acquisition cutoff. These timestamps are not collapsed.
